title: CAIRE: Cultural Attribution of Images by Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cultural representation and geographic skews in text-to-image and vision-language models using a retrieval-augmented metric (CAIRE). The metric links visual entities to a multimodal knowledge base (BabelNet) and uses a Vision-Language Model to score the image's relevance to user-defined cultural labels on a 1-5 scale, comparing the results against human judgments.
